All EventsUnsound London
Goat (jp) + Gal Go Grey
Tue, 10 November
Following a sold-out show in 2024, we are excited to welcome back one of the most formidable live acts in existence, as Japan's Goat return to the ICA this November. Support from Gal Go Grey.
Horse Lords + Damian Dalla Torre
Wed, 11 November
Horse Lords grew out of the fertile Baltimore noise and leftfield rock scene, but their approach is more omnivorous than the stippled rhythms of instrumental electric rock would indicate. Support from Damian Dalle Torre.
Gold Panda + Danalogue
Thu, 12 November
Derwin Schlecker has been making inventive, invigorating electronic music as Gold Panda for the better part of two decades now. He headlines later this year to mark the release of his new album TON UP. With support from Danalogue.
Kiss Facility
Fri, 13 November
Kiss Facility is the multidisciplinary duo of Mayah Alkhateri and Salvador Navarette, who have been working across sound, image, and performance since their first encounter. Their practice is rooted in spiritual enquiry, drawing on themes of psychic perception, ritual protection, intimacy and the afterlife as a force of future destiny. Support from Róisín El Cherif.
Faux Real
Sat, 14 November
Faux Real are known for idiosyncratic, high-energy live shows combining choreography, showmanship, and practical effects with an intentionally unfiltered physicality. They return with their second album Poison Time, later this year.
RÓIS
Tue, 17 November
RÓIS is a composer, vocalist, multi-instrumentalist, and electronic artist from Fermanagh, whose songs breathe new life into a forgotten Ireland. Blending elements of folk, sean-nós, electronics, and jazz harmony, RÓIS’ genre-bending sound transports listeners to a different realm. 
Robocobra Quartet + Lara Jones
Thu, 19 November
EFG London Jazz Festival presents Robocobra Quartet.
Lex Records presents Pink Siifu + Fly Anakin + Chuck Strangers + Quelle Chris
Fri, 20 November
Lex Records presents a stacked bill with Pink Siifu, Fly Anakin, Chuck Strangers and Quelle Chris.
Client_03
Sat, 21 November
Client_03 is the testbed.
Client_03 is a product of the internet.
Client_03 is neither person nor machine.
Client_03 is within the Host Body.
Client_03 is an invitation.
Modern Woman
Wed, 25 November
Modern Woman's debut album Johnny's Dreamworld represents the culmination of the London art-rock outfit's journey from singer Sophie Harris' intimate songwriting project into a full-bodied band capable of folding post-punk, avant-garde, and folk traditions into a live force of dynamic originality. 
Unsound London
26 – 28 November 2026
Unsound Festival comes to the ICA for a three-day residency, bringing together adventurous live music, experimental sound and a programme of talks exploring contemporary culture.
Unsound London: Footwork International
Thu, 26 November
Chicago footwork pioneer RP Boo, Polish Outlines label boss Paide, 160 Unity/Tropical Waste founder Seb Wheeler and After Werks co-founder Aoife Keane discuss footwork's latest era, the rise of footwork dance culture outside of Chicago and footwork's ongoing evolution within and beyond Chicago. Moderated by Aliyah Husna.
Unsound London: Lorenzo Senni, RP Boo & Gary Gwadera, Aleksandra Słyż
Thu, 26 November
Opening night of Unsound London at ICA brings a new live show from trance pointillist Lorenzo Senni, a cross-cultural collision of Chicago footwork and Polish oberek from RP Boo and Gary Gwadera, joined by folk and footwork dancers, and the world premiere of a new work by Polish composer and sound artist Aleksandra Słyż.
Unsound London: Visible Cloaks feat. Hashtag Ensemble, Heinali & Andriana-Yaroslava Saienko, Giant Claw & Julek ploski
Fri, 27 November
The second night of ICA's partnership with Unsound Festival, features Visible Cloaks joining forces with Poland's Hashtag Ensemble, the UK debut of Гільдеґарда by Ukrainian artists Heinali and Andriana-Yaroslava Saienko and Giant Claw joins Warsaw-based eccentric Julek ploski for an exclusive Unsound A/V commission.
Unsound London: Internet Folklores w/ Kieran Press-Reynolds & Günseli Yalcinkaya
Sat, 28 November
Kieran Press-Reynolds and Günseli Yalcinkaya join forces to explore internet folklore, digital subcultures and the feedback loops between online communities, algorithms and cultural production.
Unsound London: How to (Not) Be Heard #2 w/ Steve Goodman & Angus Carlyle
Sat, 28 November
Steve Goodman (Kode9) and Angus Carlyle presentations will engage a complex of ideas relating to sonic warfare, technologically augmented perception, and both strategic and tactical configurations of noise, silence, and deception. 
Jack Wyllie
Sun, 29 November
Portico Quartet co-founder Jack Wyllie presents the first project under his own name and introduces a new band featuring Hinako Omori on keyboards, Milo Fitzpatrick (Portico Quartet/Vega Trails) on bass, and drummer Jesse Barrett (Mammal Hands).

Planningtorock
Fri, 4 December
Planningtorock - the long-running musical project of Tallinn-based artist, producer and composer Jam Rostron - presents a special, one-off, headline show at the ICA this December They present a special, one-off, headline show at the ICA this December which will be filmed as part of a documentary about Planningtorock directed by Vic Lentaigne and Posy Dixon and produced by LUCA and Grey Moth.

TYGAPAW (live)
Sat, 5 December
TYGAPAW is a Jamaican-born, Brooklyn-based artist and composer whose multidisciplinary practice spans music, performance, design, and visual art.
Dis Fig + Microplastics
Wed, 9 December
A double header of unhinged sonic intensity with Dis Fig performing her new album and the London live debut of Microplastics, the new band from three of South London's most distinctive artists: aya, Jennifer Walton and 96 Back
Nightbus
Fri, 11 December
Nightbus are a brooding, cinematic two-piece blending post-punk, trip-hop, and late-night electronica into something dark, hypnotic and unmistakably their own.
Andy Stott + Carmen Villain + Church Andrews and Matt Davies
Sat, 12 December
Goodness present a night of shuddering dub rhythms with Andy Stott, Carmen Villain and Church Andrews & Matt Davies. 
JGrrey
Fri, 15 January 2027
Following the release of her sophomore album you, me & jen, the South London singer-songwriter headlines the ICA.
MorMor
Thu, 28 January 2027
Seth Nyquist, better known as MorMor, is a Toronto-based indie-pop musician and producer. 
Vanishing Twin
Tue, 16 February 2027
Shapeshifting trio Vanishing Twin continue their stealth mission to redefine the possibilities of the modern band on new album Archives – a collage of postmodern songcraft that finds nirvana in the shared experience of creation.

Curbside Lambsear, Gyeongsu & June, Vanessa Bedoret
Wed, 17 February 2027
Scenic Route return to ICA with new signing Curbside Lambsear, alongside Gyeongsu & June and Vanessa Bedoret.
Dog Unit
Tue, 23 February 2027
Dog Unit’s language exists beyond words; it’s not in the telling, but in the feeling. Four friends take on the scale of a mutant orchestra, a single mind of 16 limbs in perpetual forward motion and unspoken shared purpose.
Tony Njoku
Sat, 27 February 2027
Tony Njoku is an award-winning British-Nigerian composer, recording artist and multidisciplinary artist known for emotionally resonant, genre-blurring music paired with striking visual work.
Sam Quealy
Wed, 17 March 2027
The sophomore album from Sam Quealy, JAWBREAKER takes its title from the timeless candy that shares the singular character of her music: a bold confection both addictively sweet and dangerously hard, widely beloved for its potential to wreak glorious havoc. 
LA Priest
Thu, 18 March 2027
Sam Eastgate has built a reputation as a subversive, unpredictable musician, consistently innovating over the course of his work with his now defunct breakout band Late Of The Pier, his cherished Soft Hair collaboration with Connan Mockasin as well as his solo work under LA Priest.
Logic1000
Sat, 27 March 2027
Logic1000 is the moniker of Sydney-born, London-based producer and DJ Samantha Poulter. In her unique music making process, Samantha conjures concepts, genres, samples, hyper-accurate digital synths and disembodied textures. Logic is set to release her highly anticipated sophomore album Confirmation! On October 4th, following the release of her critically-acclaimed DJ Kicks: Logic1000 in 2025.
Warrington-Runcorn New Town Development Plan
Sat, 22 May 2027
Gordon Chapman-Fox’s Warrington-Runcorn New Town Development Plan project sees a bold visual aesthetic and striking retro-futuristic audio identity seamlessly melded together into one evocative musical package.
